name: smwmusic-warioware-touched-cup-runneth-over
title: WarioWare: Touched! - Cup Runneth Over
description:
The sparkly, bubbly theme from a WarioWare microgame where you help a black-and-white man blow bubbles in his colourful drink.

Due to its short length, it's probably best suited for cutscenes or something. Includes an option to disable the loop.
